chapter: Famous Door, the union dispute and Stuff Smith's last years
title: Dedicating numbers to Petrillo's mayor and Petrillo's party in Room 1432
summary: Petrillo ordered the Chicago bands to dedicate a number to his candidate, annoying the Republican manager; Petrillo later hosted a hotel-room party and had each man given a bottle of whiskey.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition

blocks.x: there was any way I could get you all out of here," he said, "You wouldn't spend another day in here." But he said, "You've been doing such great business. The place has been packed every night." He says, "I don't understand it, you guys do everything in here." I said, "Don't say you guys. Tell it to Stuff." He said, "I can't talk to him. He always runs by me all the time, you know." So now, to set it off good, now Petrillo's a tough man out there, so Petrillo's got a thing somebody's supposed to be elected there, some Mayor's running and he's Petrillo's man. Gene Krupa's out there at the Sherman and we're in the La Salle, so he called all of us down and says, "Now, look, once a night I want you to stop in the middle of a number when you've got everybody on the floor, stop in the middle of a number and say we are dedicating this number to Mayor So-and so," and he says, "If you're broadcasting, I want you to dedicate a number out of your broadcast to Mayor So-and-so," you know. So we got in there. What do we know who the Mayor is? We don't know one Mayor from the other, you know. We just come to Chicago to work. So now we stop in the middle of the number and he says, "We are dedicating this number to Mayor So-and-so," you know. So when we got off the stand, Smith says, "Jonah, Jonah, come here." He won't call Stuff. He says, "What are you doing?" I said, "What?" He said, "That's the Democrat. We're Republicans in here. What's happening now? Dedicating numbers to people and all that stuff? Who told you

to do that?" I said, "Petrillo said do it." He said, "Well, you better go ahead and do it then, if he told you." He said, "You'd better do it, then," you know. After it happened the man must have wanted something but he come in there one night and about 10:00 o'clock and we wasn't supposed to get off till 1:00, and he come in there about 10:00 o'clock and said, "You all come up in Room 1432, I'm having a little party up there."

Petrillo. Said, "Bring your instruments and things up there, you know." And we walked right on by Smith and went on upstairs, and we played, oh, two or three or four numbers while we were up there, you know. It was about 10:00 o'clock, you know, so I guess we must have sat around and had a few drinks, playing socializing, and it's about 11:00 now. The place was packed. So he said, "Now, you all can go home. You don't have to go on the stand no more tonight. You can go home." And says, "There'll be a bottle of whiskey waiting for you on your way out." So he had called them up and said, "Give each one of them a bottle of that 21-year-old Grandad, you know," and they gave each one of us one. We took it home. Sure. Tell you the truth, I had so much real life experience, especially with Stuff, it mostly happened with him.
